description: Hand-written OpenUSD rooms for the USD scene front end (tools/quality/usd_scene.py). The analytic expectations are restated in tools/quality/tests/test_usd_corpus_rooms.py and FixtureSpecTest proves each layer authors them; known usd_scene defects they expose are in tools/quality/tests/test_usd_corpus_defects.py. Each layer's doc metadata names this version.

box_room_cm_yup.usda.purpose: Y-up cm; explicit 8-vertex boxes under translate/rotateY/scale, a negative-scale mirror, a UsdGeom.Cube recorded as skipped (spec: BOX_CM)

box_room_in_zup.usda.purpose: Z-up inches (metersPerUnit 0.0254); rotateZ 30 parent, leftHanded box authored clockwise (spec: BOX_IN)

materials.usda.purpose: MaterialX-only, custom universal id, no surface, textured UsdPreviewSurface, preview beside mtlx, MDL source asset (spec: MATERIALS)

seeded/box_room_cm_wrong_units.usda.purpose: negative control: sublayers box_room_cm_yup.usda, root metersPerUnit 0.1 instead of 0.01

seeded/st_transforms_wrong_rotation.usda.purpose: negative control: sublayers st_transforms.usda, seeds Full's rotation -30 instead of 30

st_transforms.usda.purpose: UsdTransform2d scale/rotation/translation on the primvar reader chain, interface-connected rotation and primvar name, indexed faceVarying uvB, differing per-texture transforms (spec: ST, ST_LITERALS)

textures/checker.png.purpose: 2x2 RGB checker written with the Python standard library (zlib), read by st_transforms.usda and materials.usda

produced_by: hand-written 2026-09-25 (no generator; edit the .usda text, bump version, update the spec constants and these digests together)
